description: Source code implementing a linked list for managing monitor UUIDs and callbacks in OvsDbApi, including functions to add, process, remove, and clear list entries.

methods.name: mon_list_add
methods.description: Adds a UUID and callback to the monitor list.

methods.name: mon_list_process
methods.description: Processes a UUID by invoking its callback if present.

methods.name: mon_list_remove
methods.description: Removes a UUID from the monitor list.
